events.title: Erik Jekabson Quintet plays "A Tale of Three Cities"
performers: Erik Jekabson Quintet plays "A Tale of Three Cities"
events.description: A Tale of Three Cities. Erik Jekabson plays original music inspired by three important cities in the development of jazz: New Orleans, New York and San Francisco. A Bay Area native who's lived in all three locations, Erik brings his top-notch quintet into Keys to pay musical tribute to all three inspiring locations. Personnel: Erik[...]
